I am a postdoctoral researcher at the Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics and the Institute for Quantum Computing at the University of Waterloo.

My research lies at the interface of mathematical physics, quantum information theory, and operator algebras. I am interested in the mathematical structure of quantum theory, with a particular focus on operator-algebraic methods and quantum correlations.

## Research interests

- Operator algebras

- Quantum information theory

- Mathematical physics

- Quantum correlations

- Nonlocality

- Many-body quantum systems
